column1: # FT-710 DISPLAY: T11g name proposals (misc peripherals, GIC, RTC, WAV recorder, SD user files). Same format as names_display.tsv.
# Merge into names_display.tsv after the parent's rename pass. Evidence: docs/code/display/peripherals.md.
# Entries marked "NEW ENTRY" need the function created first (tools/ghidra/entries_display.T11g.tsv).
# --- GPIO / PFC pin configuration (port base table at 0x20800000: Pn; +0x300 PM, +0x400 PMC, +0x500 PFC, +0x600 PFCE, +0xA00 PFCAE, +0x4000 PIBC, +0x4100 PBDC, +0x4200 PIPC)

column3: (port,pin,func,mode): PMC=1, alt function; mode 0 PIPC, 1 in, 2 out, 3 bidir
(Pn ptr, mask|value<<16, flag): bulk port-mode pin set-up
P3_4 LCD_DEN alt1, P11_15 LCD_CLK alt5 (or inputs)
P8_5 (SDR_MOSI) port level, used by the reboot sequence
P7_12 = SDPWS (SD card power switch), 1-tick delay on power-up
P5_9 DVR0 / P5_8 DVR1 (lines to the MAIN DVI chain)
P5_0..P5_7 LVDS (RA..RCK pairs) alt1, or output low
one front LED (P6 pin table) on/off
8 front LEDs from a bit mask (D_RED, D_GREEN, D_WHITE, D_BLUE, RXBUSY, TX, STEPCH, VOX)
P4_7 BLPWM alt3 (MTU2 out) + P10_4 level, or input
Reset_Handler: PL310 power ctrl, FRQCR 0x0035, FRQCR2 1, SYSCR3 0x0F, STBCR2..12
STBREQ2/STBACK2 handshake, then STBCR9 bit (module stop)
WDT reset mode, WTCNT=0xFF: resets the chip almost at once
1: WDT reset; 2: P0 pin set-up then WDT reset
FS off, LCD/LVDS off, MAIN reset pulse, flash reset, wdt_system_reset
system time (us) interpolated from the OSTM0 counter
distributor/CPU interface set-up, 587 handler slots = gic_default_handler
pops nesting stack, EOIR + PMR restore
copies a 0x58-byte ISR stub, sets priority and handler slot
(intno, {attr, handler, prio}) direct handler, no stub

column1: # --- RTC S-35190A (3-wire bit-bang on P1_0 DT, P1_1 CK, P1_2 CS via PSR1 0xFCFE3104; LSB first)

column3: struct tm (year+100, mon-1); used by the FAT layer for time stamps
writes status2 = 1 and INT1 = 1 (from MAIN message 0x62)
port idle, status1 = 2 (24 h), status2 = 0, creates the RTC mutex 0x20800368
MTU2 ch3/ch4 reset-synchronised PWM, period 320 counts, TIOC4D out
MTU2 ch0 PWM mode 1, P0/16, period 20000 (100 Hz), TIOC0A out

column1: # --- voice recorder / player (task "audio_codec"): WAV files in I:\FT-710\MESSAGE (kind 2) and \PlayList (kind 1)

column3: scans the folder for *.wav, up to 255 entries of 0x34 bytes, sorted
(name16, freq digits, mode index, kind): sets event flag 2
reads 0xC80 bytes, keeps the left channel, header {count/2, 0x1234}
pads to 4 bytes, rewrites the 0x5C-byte header sizes
sends (type, buffer) to the audio mailbox 0x208000C4

column1: # --- SD user files: MemList / Menu backups (task sdmenu)

column3: 9 x 64-byte text lines ("MemList  n  CRC") + 0x7D10 encoded bytes
RENAME (was sfl_load_file): loads a MemList/Menu .dat (size 0x7F50), checks CRC, type and model word
starts save (flag 1) or load (flag 2), polls result
